note: Feature cards for validation.html. Edit by hand or with hindcast_dropin.py, then run build_pages.py. image: path under site/pages. text: one to three short lines of plain comparison with the archived NAM.

cases.title: CAD ice storm
cases.when: 23 Jan 2026 12Z run, Georgia and the Carolinas, f39
text: Freezing rain and sleet cover 295k km², the same as the NAM’s. The sub-freezing wedge covers 393k km² against the NAM’s 397k.

cases.title: Snowcrete
cases.when: 5 Jan 2025 12Z run, Washington DC, snow to sleet, f21
text: Snow, sleet and freezing rain cover 130k, 66k and 16k km² against the NAM’s 153k, 41k and 45k: the same pattern, with more sleet and less freezing rain. By f36 both are all snow.

cases.title: Gulf Coast snow
text: The same snow band as the NAM’s, with a larger area: 24 h snow above 5 cm covers 255k km² against the NAM’s 201k at f30 (27 % larger), and 163k against 116k at f42 (40 % larger).
Heaviest 24 h snow: 32.2 cm against 23.6 cm at f30, 20.9 against 23.6 cm at f42.

cases.title: PNW bomb cyclone
cases.when: 19 Nov 2024 12Z run, with an atmospheric river, f12
text: The low is 946.9 hPa at f12 and 954.1 at f24, against the NAM’s 941.0 and 950.3: about 6 and 4 hPa weaker. The track is within 0.2°; peak 10 m wind is 29.2 against 29.7 m/s.
